data.title: 帕瓦 · 午后草坪的猫咪午睡
data.description: 微风轻拂的阳光公园草地上，帕瓦仰面平躺在花草间，浅金长发散开，将爱猫咪咪紧紧抱在怀里，脸上露出少见的恬静无防备睡颜。
data.action: lying on grass, hugging cat Meowy, peaceful sleeping smile
data.lighting: warm golden afternoon sunbeams filtering through tree canopy
data.promptProse: Sprawled peacefully on a lush green lawn beneath sun-dappled trees, Power cuddles her beloved cat Meowy to her chest, her expression surprisingly calm and serene.
data.animaCaption: Power napping peacefully on a grassy lawn while cuddling her cat.
